the i.c. route of heterotransplanting SCCL into nude mice provides a more rapid and efficient method of establishing a transplantable SCCL tumor than the s.c. route, and that the i.c.-established SCCL tumors are more representative of the original SC CL tumor.

intracranial heterotransplant of SCCL into nude mice can be used to model meningeal carcinomas, which is a common complication of lung cancer.
